data.text: I appreciate everyone’s concern, but I’ve already committed to 2 tons this month, and I’ll honor that. With the four of you at 10, our total would be 42 tons. Would John and Kate each be willing to take 14 instead, with Jack and Emma staying at 10? That totals 50 tons, earns John and Kate $14,000 each, and leaves enough fish to return to 100 after reproduction. I’m voluntarily offering the smaller share for this month; it doesn’t oblige anyone to do the same later. John, would you accept 14 under that revised split?
